name: maze-bench-5x5-v0.1
description: A small-scale 5x5 maze benchmark designed to evaluate agents on navigation, planning, and goal-reaching in grid mazes. Tasks typically require an agent to observe the environment (often visual or symbolic) and produce action sequences to reach a target. The suite is useful for comparing reinforcement learning and planning algorithms on short-horizon maze problems.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited but steady use among reinforcement learning and navigation researchers and hobbyists.
